context:
Goal: settle Card in Hand's open choices, so Duo can plan the build.
Problem: the round-2 drawing offered one stamp button on the past-transit page. You expected two, Claim filed and Lost. The app today has six stamp kinds (Claim filed, Seller contacted, Refunded, Reshipped, Partial refund, Other) and no Lost.
Based on: STAMP_KINDS in the web app's src/app.jsx (read).
Meanwhile: Duo plans the build and starts nothing until you answer.
holds: Duo's build plan for Card in Hand waits on this.

options.gain: The two you expect, one tap each.
options.how: Add Lost as a new stamp kind. Both buttons sit on each late package.
options.label: Two buttons: Claim filed and Lost
options.lose: Lost is new data: the web app and the phone app both have to learn it.

options.gain: No new data; it works like Packages.
options.how: The past-transit page offers the same stamp list as Packages.
options.label: The six stamps the app already has
options.lose: No Lost stamp, and six buttons where you expected two.

ref: Duo design round 2, draft PR #144 (Card in Hand screens)
title: Which stamps can you put on a late package from the past-transit page?
why: It matches what you asked for. The new kind is a small addition to one list.
